products.name: Commercial Real Estate and Multi-Family Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of loans secured by commercial real estate and multi-family properties, primarily small office buildings, shopping centers, apartment buildings, and mixed-use properties. These loans are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced through in-person and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of loans for the construction of commercial, residential, and mixed-use properties, including land acquisition and development. These loans are physically originated, require ongoing inspection and disbursement, and are secured by real estate and personal guarantees, involving regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to small and mid-sized businesses for working capital, equipment, and general business purposes, secured by business assets, real estate, and personal guarantees. These loans are physically originated and serviced, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential First-Lien Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of first-lien mortgage loans for one-to-four family residential properties, including both conforming and non-conforming loans. These loans are physically originated and serviced, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of home equity loans, lines of credit, and other consumer loans to individuals, primarily secured by residential real estate. These loans are physically originated and serviced, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a full range of deposit products to individuals and businesses, including checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and attorney trust accounts. These services are delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Sale and management of investment securities, including mortgage-backed securities, U.S. government agency securities, obligations of state and political subdivisions, SBA securities, and U.S. treasury securities. These are managed as part of the bank's investment portfolio and may be offered to customers as part of wealth management or investment services.

products.name: Standard Community Banking Services
products.description: Provision of ancillary banking services such as money orders, cashier’s checks, wire transfers, safe deposit boxes, debit cards, remote deposit capture, and ATM access. These services are delivered through physical and digital channels and support the core banking relationship.

products.name: Online and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Digital banking services including online account access, bill payment, transaction histories, account-to-account transfers, and mobile banking, delivered via the bank’s website and mobile applications through third-party technology providers.

products.name: Agricultural Equipment Sales
products.description: Sale of new and used agricultural machinery and attachments, including equipment for large-scale commercial farming, home and garden, and property maintenance. Equipment is sourced from CNH and other manufacturers and delivered through physical retail stores.

products.name: Construction Equipment Sales
products.description: Sale of new and used construction machinery, including heavy construction, light industrial, and road/highway equipment. Products are sourced from CNH and other manufacturers and sold through physical retail stores.

products.name: Equipment Parts Sales
products.description: Sale of replacement and maintenance parts for agricultural and construction equipment, maintained in extensive in-house inventories and available both in-store and online. Parts are sourced from CNH and other manufacturers.

products.name: Equipment Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of set-up, repair, and maintenance services for agricultural and construction equipment, including warranty repairs, performed both in-store and at customer locations by trained technicians.

products.name: Equipment Rental Services
products.description: Rental of agricultural and construction equipment, primarily in the Construction segment, for periods ranging from days to full seasons. Rental fleet is managed and serviced by in-house teams and marketed through retail sales force.

products.name: Precision Farming and Farm Data Management Products and Services
products.description: Sale and support of precision farming technology, including GPS signal subscriptions and farm data management products, delivered as ancillary products and services to agricultural customers.

products.name: Equipment Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of equipment transportation services as an ancillary offering to customers purchasing or renting equipment, utilizing company-managed logistics.

products.name: Equipment Financing and Insurance Products (CNH)
products.description: Offering of financing and insurance products to end-user customers, primarily through CNH Capital and other third-party providers, as part of the equipment sales process.

products.name: Program Sponsorship (Card Issuance and Deposit Accounts)
products.description: Issuance and sponsorship of debit, credit, and prepaid cards (including consumer, business, payroll, gift, government, and incentive cards) and associated deposit accounts, delivered through fintech and other partners. The Bank provides card network access, maintains deposits, and acts as sponsor bank of record. Requires regulated banking infrastructure and technology integration with partners.

products.name: Payment Processing Services
products.description: Provision of real-time, end-to-end payment processing solutions, including ACH, Rapid Funds Transfer, and merchant acquiring services. These services facilitate bill payments, merchant settlements, and support for fintech partners, leveraging regulated payment networks and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Sponsored Lending (Fintech Loans)
products.description: Origination of short-term loans, including secured credit cards and unsecured payroll advance or other short-term credit, in partnership with fintech companies. Loans are originated by the Bank, with marketing and servicing by partners, and are governed by credit enhancement agreements. Delivered digitally via partner platforms.

products.name: Real Estate Bridge Lending (REBL)
products.description: Provision of commercial real estate bridge loans for the purchase and rehabilitation of multi-family workforce housing and other cash-flowing properties. Loans are typically collateralized by real estate, have multi-year terms, and are managed through specialized underwriting and risk management.

products.name: Institutional Banking (Wealth Management Lending)
products.description: Lending and banking services to wealth management clients, including securities-backed lines of credit (SBLOCs), insurance policy cash value-backed lines of credit (IBLOCs), and loans to investment advisors. These are collateralized loans, often integrated with brokerage accounts, and require specialized financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Small Business Lending (SBA and Commercial Loans)
products.description: Origination of loans to small businesses, primarily through SBA programs (7(a) and 504), as well as non-real estate business loans and commercial mortgages. These loans are collateralized by business assets or real estate and require compliance with government lending standards.

products.name: Direct Lease Financing (Fleet and Equipment Leasing)
products.description: Provision of vehicle fleet leasing and equipment leasing services to commercial and government entities. Leases are typically for 36 to 60 months and require asset management, financing, and servicing capabilities.

products.name: Regulated Water Utility Services
products.description: Provision of water and wastewater utility services to residential, commercial, industrial, and fire protection customers, primarily through owned and operated water treatment plants, well stations, and wastewater treatment facilities, under regulated tariffs in multiple states.

products.name: Regulated Natural Gas Utility Services
products.description: Distribution and delivery of natural gas to residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation customers, primarily through owned and operated pipelines, storage facilities, and gathering systems, under regulated tariffs in Pennsylvania and Kentucky.

products.name: Utility Service Line Protection and Repair Services
products.description: Provision of utility service line protection solutions and repair services to households, offered through non-regulated subsidiaries as market-based activities.

products.name: Gas Marketing and Production Activities
products.description: Non-regulated marketing and production of natural gas, including activities related to gas supply and sales outside of regulated utility operations.

products.name: Freight Forwarding Services
products.description: Non-asset-based arrangement and management of domestic and international shipments via air, ocean, and ground carriers, utilizing advanced information technology systems to monitor and coordinate all aspects of material flow. Services are delivered through a network of company-owned and partner locations.

products.name: Freight Brokerage Services
products.description: Matching customer shipping needs with carrier capacity for truckload, less-than-truckload (LTL), and intermodal transportation, including rate negotiation, shipment tracking, and claims handling, managed through centralized service centers and technology platforms.

products.name: Intermodal Transportation Services
products.description: Arrangement of long-distance freight movement using a combination of truck and rail, including contracting with railroads for long-haul and local trucking companies for pickup and delivery, with electronic tracking and consolidated billing.

products.name: Air and Ocean Freight Services
products.description: Coordination of international and domestic air and ocean freight shipments, including heavyweight and small package air services, air charters, and time-definite surface transport, leveraging commercial flights and ocean carriers without owning transportation assets.

products.name: Materials Management and Distribution (MM&D) Services
products.description: Value-added logistics services including warehousing, inventory management, and distribution, supporting customer supply chains with storage and movement of goods, often integrated with transportation services.

products.name: Customs House Brokerage (CHB) Services
products.description: Assistance with customs clearance and compliance for international shipments, including preparation of documentation and coordination with customs authorities, delivered by licensed professionals.

products.name: Global Trade Management (GTM) Services
products.description: Provision of technology-enabled solutions for managing global supply chains, including purchase order and vendor management, SKU-level visibility, and compliance support, delivered through proprietary platforms.

products.name: Wellhead and Pressure Control Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sells, and rents wellhead systems, production trees, frac trees, and related pressure control equipment for onshore unconventional oil and gas wells. These products are physically manufactured in facilities in the US, China, and Vietnam and delivered to customers for use during drilling, completion, and production phases.

products.name: Spoolable Pipe and Fittings
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells spoolable pipe and associated end fittings under the FlexSteel brand, primarily used as production, gathering, and takeaway pipelines for oil, gas, or other liquids. Manufactured in Baytown, Texas using proprietary equipment and delivered to customers for rapid well production.

products.name: Equipment Rental Services
products.description: Provides rental of pressure control equipment (such as frac trees and installation tools) and spoolable pipe installation equipment to oil and gas operators, supporting drilling and completion activities. Rental equipment is manufactured and maintained by the company and delivered to customer sites as needed.

products.name: Field Services (Installation, Maintenance, and Handling)
products.description: Offers field services for installation, maintenance, and handling of both pressure control and spoolable pipe products, including repair and refurbishment. Services are delivered by skilled personnel through service centers and pipe yards in key oil and gas regions.

products.name: Homeowners Insurance
products.description: Porch provides homeowners insurance policies, primarily through managing and operating a reciprocal insurance exchange. Insurance is underwritten using proprietary property data and is delivered via digital and agent channels, with risk partially ceded to reinsurers.

products.name: Home Warranty Products
products.description: Porch offers a range of home warranty products, including whole-home, service line, and extended labor warranties, sold directly to consumers and through partners. These products are designed to cover breakdowns and reduce unexpected costs for homeowners.

products.name: Home Services Marketplace (Moving, Utilities, Security)
products.description: Porch operates a marketplace connecting consumers with moving services (labor-only and full-service), as well as facilitating setup of home utilities, TV/Internet, and security services. Delivery is via digital platforms and concierge support.

products.name: Home Services Software (SaaS)
products.description: Porch provides software-as-a-service solutions to home inspectors, mortgage providers, title companies, and roofers. Products include inspection management, real estate transaction security, mortgage workflow, and roofing measurement tools, delivered via cloud-based platforms.

products.name: Property Data and Analytics Solutions
products.description: Porch offers property data and analytics products, such as Home Factors, providing detailed interior and exterior property attributes and condition data. These solutions are sold to insurance carriers and other third parties to improve underwriting, pricing, and customer acquisition.

products.name: Precision Psychiatry Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of clinical-stage, brain-based, biomarker-driven drug candidates for neuropsychiatric conditions such as major depressive disorder, bipolar depression, treatment resistant depression, schizophrenia, and Parkinson’s disease. These are small molecule drugs, some as fixed-dose combinations, developed through proprietary neurobiological insights and delivered as oral or transdermal pharmaceuticals, requiring regulated clinical trials and manufacturing.

products.name: Precision Psychiatry Platform (Biomarker Discovery and Patient Stratification)
products.description: A proprietary, scalable digital platform that integrates neurocognitive assessments, EEG, wearable device data, and genetic/genomic samples, using machine learning analytics to discover and validate brain-based biomarkers for patient selection and drug response prediction. The platform is designed for commercial scalability and integration into clinical practice, and may be licensed or partnered for use in drug development and clinical care.

products.name: Retail Point-of-Sale (POS) Platform and Services
products.description: Integrated POS hardware and software solutions for independent retailers, including terminals, inventory management, sales tracking, and operational tools, delivered via physical devices and SaaS plans. Includes merchant payment processing, display advertising, and retail data analytics services.

products.name: Payment Processing Services
products.description: Merchant services enabling retailers to accept and process credit, debit, and electronic benefit transfer payments, provided through POS terminals and payment processing equipment, with various pricing plans and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Retail Media and Data Analytics Services
products.description: Digital advertising on POS terminal screens and licensing of retail transaction data and analytics to third parties, leveraging a nationwide network of customer-facing screens and transaction-level data for targeted marketing and business insights.

products.name: International Money Transfer (Remittance) Services
products.description: Fintech-based cross-border money transfer services for consumers, enabling digital and cash-initiated remittances from the U.S. to over 50 countries, delivered via mobile apps and a network of retail agents, with compliance and payout network management.

products.name: Unified Communications and Contact Center Solutions (UCaaS/CCaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based unified communications (UCaaS), contact center (CCaaS), and AI-powered communication solutions for businesses, including voice, video, messaging, analytics, and integrations, delivered via SaaS platforms and mobile/web apps.

products.name: AI-Powered Communication and Workforce Solutions
products.description: AI-driven autonomous agents for customer-facing tasks and workforce intelligence/coaching platforms, providing real-time insights, automation, and productivity tools for business communications across multiple channels.

products.name: Prepaid Digital Payment Services
products.description: Prepaid digital offerings such as mobile airtime top-up, data bundles, digital gift cards, and eSIMs, delivered to consumers and businesses via digital channels, retail networks, and a B2B prepaid-as-a-service platform (Zendit).

products.name: International Long-Distance Calling Services
products.description: Prepaid international long-distance voice calling services, primarily for immigrant communities, delivered via mobile apps, prepaid hard cards, and a network of retail agents, with account management and top-up features.

products.name: Wholesale International Voice and SMS Termination Services
products.description: Wholesale carrier services for international voice and SMS traffic termination and outsourced traffic management, serving telecoms, carriers, and businesses worldwide via a global telecommunications network and digital self-service portal.

products.name: Children’s Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Manufactured and sourced apparel and accessories for babies, toddlers, and children (sizes newborn to 14), sold under Carter’s, OshKosh B’gosh, Child of Mine, Just One You, Simple Joys, Little Planet, and Otter Avenue brands through retail, eCommerce, and wholesale channels. Products include bodysuits, layette essentials, sleepwear, playclothes, denim, dresses, and multi-piece sets. Production is outsourced to third-party manufacturers, primarily in Asia, and distributed globally.

products.name: Sustainable and Organic Children’s Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Apparel, sleepwear, swimwear, outerwear, bedding, accessories, and toys for babies and toddlers, produced with organic and sustainable materials under the Little Planet brand. Products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed via retail, eCommerce, and wholesale channels at premium price points.

products.name: Baby and Toddler Essentials and Gear
products.description: Designed, sourced, and marketed products for parents, babies, and toddlers under the Skip Hop brand, including diaper bags, kids’ bags, home gear, and products for playtime, mealtime, bath time, and travel. Products are manufactured by third parties and sold through retail, eCommerce, and wholesale channels.

products.name: Licensed Children’s Lifestyle Products
products.description: Licensed products developed and sold by partners under Carter’s, OshKosh, Child of Mine, Just One You, Simple Joys, and Little Planet brands, including footwear, outerwear, accessories, toys, home décor, cribs, baby furniture, and bedding. Licensing partners manufacture and distribute these products through multiple sales channels.

products.name: Oil, Natural Gas, and NGL Production
products.description: The company acquires, develops, and produces oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGLs) from wells located primarily in the Anadarko, San Juan, and Permian Basins. This involves physical extraction using drilling, completion, and production operations, requiring significant capital investment, regulated infrastructure, and in-person labor.

products.name: Midstream Services
products.description: The company owns and operates midstream assets, including gathering systems, processing plants, and water infrastructure, which are used to transport, process, and manage oil, gas, and water. These assets are also used to provide gathering, processing, and water disposal services to third parties, generating external revenue.

products.name: Product Sales (Non-Hydrocarbon)
products.description: The company generates revenue from the sale of products not specified as oil, natural gas, or NGLs. The nature of these products is not detailed, but they are sold externally and generate a distinct revenue stream, likely related to byproducts or surplus materials from operations.

products.name: Property Catastrophe Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance coverage protecting insurance and reinsurance companies against natural and man-made catastrophes (e.g., earthquakes, hurricanes, terrorism), primarily written on an excess of loss basis and delivered globally through underwriting and risk modeling expertise.

products.name: Other Property Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for property risks beyond catastrophe, including proportional reinsurance, property per risk, delegated authority arrangements, and regional multi-line reinsurance, delivered through underwriting subsidiaries and joint ventures.

products.name: Casualty Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for general casualty risks such as automobile liability, employers’ liability, umbrella/excess casualty, workers’ compensation, and general liability, written predominantly on a proportional basis and delivered through underwriting platforms and delegated authority arrangements.

products.name: Professional Liability Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for professional liability risks, including directors and officers, medical malpractice, professional indemnity, and transactional liability, provided mainly on a proportional and excess of loss basis to insurers worldwide.

products.name: Credit Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for credit-related risks such as financial guaranty, mortgage guaranty, political risk, surety, and trade credit, delivered through proportional and excess of loss structures to insurance companies globally.

products.name: Specialty Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for specialty lines including accident and health, agriculture, aviation, construction, cyber, energy, marine, satellite, and terrorism, provided through tailored proportional and excess of loss contracts.

products.name: Insurance Solutions (via Delegated Authority)
products.description: Insurance products, including excess and surplus, general liability, and professional liability, written primarily through delegated authority arrangements and managed as portfolios using reinsurance expertise and risk modeling.

products.name: Third-Party Capital Management (Joint Ventures and Managed Funds)
products.description: Management of joint ventures and funds (e.g., DaVinci, Fontana, Medici, Vermeer, Top Layer, Upsilon) that invest in reinsurance and insurance-linked risks, generating management and performance fees by providing access to risk portfolios and investment strategies for institutional investors.

products.name: Catastrophe Bond Investment Management
products.description: Investment management services focused on property catastrophe bonds and other insurance-linked securities, offered to institutional investors through dedicated funds (e.g., Medici, Medici UCITS), leveraging proprietary risk modeling and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Live Biotherapeutic Products for Precision Dermatology
products.description: Topical therapies using genetically engineered live bacteria (primarily S. epidermidis) designed to deliver therapeutic proteins or peptides directly to the skin to treat dermatological diseases. These products are developed through proprietary microbial engineering and require specialized manufacturing and regulatory compliance for live biotherapeutics.

products.name: Engineered Protein Therapeutics for Skin Diseases
products.description: Topical recombinant protein therapies produced by genetically engineered bacteria, designed to supplement or replace deficient or dysfunctional proteins in the skin. These products are manufactured using synthetic biology and protein engineering, and delivered via topical formulations for targeted skin conditions.

products.name: Cosmeceutical and Consumer Health Products from Skin Bacterial Lysates and Proteins
products.description: Potential future products derived from skin bacterial lysates and proteins, developed using the company's microbial engineering platform, intended for cosmetic and consumer health applications. These products would be manufactured using biotechnological processes and may be delivered as topical formulations.

products.name: Recreation Lending
products.description: Origination of secured consumer loans for the purchase of recreational vehicles (RVs), boats, collector cars, and other consumer recreational equipment. Loans are originated through a network of dealers and financial service providers, are fixed-rate, and serviced by a third-party loan servicer.

products.name: Home Improvement Lending
products.description: Origination of secured consumer installment loans for home improvement projects such as window, siding, and roof replacement, swimming pool installations, and other renovations. Loans are offered through contractors and financial service providers, with digital tools supporting in-home sales and flexible promotional options.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Origination of subordinated loans to U.S. lower middle market businesses, primarily for acquisitions, recapitalizations, ownership transitions, and growth initiatives. Loans are typically secured by a second lien on business assets and may include equity or profit participation components.

products.name: Strategic Partnership Lending
products.description: Origination and sale of loans and receivables facilitated by financial technology (fintech) partners. The company originates loans on behalf of fintech companies and sells them to partners or third parties, earning program and transaction fees.

products.name: Taxi Medallion Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of loans secured by New York City taxi medallions, historically a primary business line. Loans are secured by the medallion and personal guarantees, with the ability to repossess and sell collateral upon default.

products.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Production and Export
products.description: Production and export of LNG from modular, factory-fabricated liquefaction facilities in Louisiana, utilizing mid-scale electric motor driven trains and integrated pipeline infrastructure. LNG is sold globally under long-term, medium-term, and spot contracts, delivered FOB, DPU, or DES from company-operated terminals.

products.name: LNG Shipping and Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of LNG shipping and logistics using a fleet of owned and chartered LNG tankers, managing delivery commitments and optimizing cargo destinations for customers worldwide. Includes management of shipping portfolio and regasification access in key import markets.

products.name: LNG Regasification and Market Access Services
products.description: Securing and providing LNG regasification capacity at terminals in the United Kingdom and Greece, enabling direct supply of regasified natural gas to downstream customers in European markets.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipeline Transportation Services
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of natural gas pipelines to transport feed gas from U.S. shale basins to company LNG facilities, including interstate and intrastate pipelines such as TransCameron, Gator Express, CP Express, Blackfin, Marais, and Cloud Connector pipelines. Pipeline capacity may be offered to third parties as part of integrated LNG supply solutions.

products.name: HeartBeam System (Ambulatory 12-Lead ECG Monitoring Platform)
products.description: A cable-free, credit card-sized 3D ECG recording device with integrated electrodes, patient smartphone application, physician web portal, and cloud-based algorithms for high-fidelity ambulatory cardiac monitoring and arrhythmia assessment. The system enables patients to record and transmit synthesized 12-lead ECGs from anywhere for remote physician review and diagnosis. Delivered as a physical device with supporting digital infrastructure and on-demand cardiologist services.

products.name: Extended Wear 12-Lead ECG Patch Monitor
products.description: A wearable, adhesive patch-based ECG monitor that provides synthesized 12-lead ECG capabilities for extended ambulatory cardiac monitoring. Designed to be similar in form factor to existing single-lead patches but with enhanced diagnostic depth, enabling long-term, high-fidelity data collection for arrhythmia and ischemia detection. Delivered as a physical wearable device with supporting software.

products.name: AI-Based Cardiac Diagnostic Algorithms and Data Services
products.description: Cloud-based artificial intelligence algorithms and data analytics services that provide automated classification, screening, and prediction of cardiac conditions using longitudinal ECG data collected from HeartBeam devices. Delivered digitally as software and data services to enhance diagnostic accuracy and predictive capabilities for healthcare providers and patients.

products.name: On-Demand Cardiologist Interpretation and Consultation Services
products.description: Remote, board-certified cardiologist review and consultation services available 24/7/365 to interpret patient ECG data, provide diagnostic recommendations, and consult with patients based on transmitted ECG signals and symptoms. Delivered as a telehealth service integrated with HeartBeam’s monitoring platform.

products.name: Future Smartwatch-Based 12-Lead ECG Monitor (Planned)
products.description: A planned smartwatch-based monitor integrating synthesized 12-lead ECG capabilities for detection of heart attacks and complex arrhythmias, eliminating the need for a dedicated ECG device. Intended to be delivered as a wearable digital device with embedded HeartBeam technology and software.

products.name: Mission Critical Networks (MCN)
products.description: Integrated communications systems and devices, including land mobile radio (LMR), mobile ad-hoc network (MANET) technology, and broadband devices, designed and manufactured for public safety, defense, and enterprise customers. Delivered through physical infrastructure, devices, installation, integration, and ongoing managed and support services.

products.name: Video Security and Access Control
products.description: Comprehensive video security and access control solutions, including AI-powered cameras (fixed, body-worn, in-vehicle), sensors, infrastructure, and software for video management, monitoring, and analytics. Delivered as physical hardware, on-premises or cloud-based software, and managed services to government, public safety, and enterprise customers.

products.name: Command Center Software Solutions
products.description: Cloud-native, on-premises, and hybrid software applications and AI-powered capabilities that unify voice and data from public safety agencies, enterprises, and the community, supporting the entire public safety workflow from 911 call through case closure. Delivered as digital software platforms, including interoperability and workflow acceleration tools.

products.name: Managed and Support Services
products.description: Comprehensive managed and support services for mission-critical networks, video security, and command center solutions, including repair, technical support, preventative maintenance, system monitoring, software updates, cybersecurity, and full operational support. Delivered through in-person and remote human labor, digital monitoring, and subscription models.

products.name: Cybersecurity Services
products.description: Cybersecurity subscription services and advanced security offerings for communications, video, and command center systems, including system monitoring, software updates, and incident response. Delivered as digital services and ongoing support to ensure system security and compliance.

products.name: Advanced Nuclear Microreactors
products.description: Design, development, and future manufacturing of advanced, modular, and portable microreactors (KRONOS MMR, LOKI MMR, ZEUS, and formerly ODIN) for scalable, clean energy generation. These reactors are engineered for both stationary and mobile applications, using proprietary designs and advanced fuel, and are intended for deployment in industrial, institutional, remote, and defense settings. Delivery will require physical manufacturing, regulatory licensing, and on-site installation.

products.name: Nuclear Fuel Processing and Supply
products.description: Development and future operation of facilities to process and supply low-enriched uranium (LEU) and high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) nuclear fuel for both internal use in company reactors and external sale to the broader advanced nuclear reactor industry. This business involves physical processing, enrichment, conversion, and fabrication of nuclear fuel, requiring regulated infrastructure and compliance with nuclear safety standards.

products.name: Nuclear Fuel Transportation Services
products.description: Development and future commercialization of high-capacity, NRC-certified transportation systems for moving commercial quantities of HALEU and other advanced nuclear fuels. This includes the design, licensing, and operation of specialized transport packages and logistics services for nuclear fuel, serving both internal needs and external customers in the nuclear industry. Delivery requires regulated logistics infrastructure and compliance with nuclear material transport regulations.

products.name: Nuclear Consulting and Support Services
products.description: Provision of nuclear service support and consulting services to external customers in the nuclear energy industry, including regulatory advice, site assessment, roadmap development, and stakeholder engagement. Services are delivered by expert personnel and may be expanded through acquisition of existing consultancy businesses. Delivery is primarily through in-person and remote human labor and expertise.

products.name: Laboratory Consumables and Supplies
products.description: A broad range of lab products and consumables, including ultra-high purity chemicals, reagents, lab supplies, analytical sample prep kits, education and clinical trial kits, and microbiology kits. These are manufactured in-house or sourced from third parties and distributed globally through physical and digital channels.

products.name: Specialty Chemicals and Bioprocessing Materials
products.description: Proprietary and third-party high-purity chemicals, reagents, excipients, and process chromatography resins and columns for use in biopharmaceutical, healthcare, and advanced technology manufacturing. These products are produced in cGMP-compliant facilities with stringent quality controls.

products.name: High-Purity Silicone Materials
products.description: Manufacture and supply of highly specialized, high-purity silicone materials for medical implants, medical devices, and aerospace applications, produced in regulated facilities to exacting purity and performance specifications.

products.name: Laboratory and Production Equipment & Instrumentation
products.description: Distribution and manufacturing of laboratory and production equipment such as filtration systems, incubators, analytical instruments, freezers, peristaltic pumps, biological safety cabinets, and fluid handling systems. These products are delivered through global distribution networks and digital platforms.

products.name: Fluid Handling Systems and Components
products.description: Design, manufacture, and distribution of fluid handling products, including tubing, pump systems, and single-use assemblies for research, industrial, and bioprocessing applications. These are proprietary and third-party products delivered globally.

products.name: Scientific and Laboratory Services
products.description: Provision of onsite laboratory and production services, including procurement, logistics, inventory management, equipment tracking, glassware autoclaving, DNA extraction, media preparation, bioreactor servicing, compound management, and cleanroom control and maintenance. Services are delivered by specialized personnel at customer sites or remotely.

products.name: Specialty Procurement and Sourcing Services
products.description: Specialty procurement and sourcing services for laboratory and production materials, including value-added solutions to streamline supply chains and ensure reliable access to mission-critical products. Delivered through digital platforms and dedicated procurement teams.

products.name: Skin Care Products
products.description: A broad range of skin care products including moisturizers, serums, cleansers, toners, eye care, body care, exfoliators, acne and oil correctors, facial masks, and sun care. These are physically manufactured and distributed globally through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Makeup Products
products.description: Extensive array of makeup products including foundations, powders, concealers, setting sprays, lipsticks, lip liners, lip glosses, mascaras, eyeshadows, eyeliners, and related tools. These are physically manufactured and sold through retail and online channels.

products.name: Fragrance Products
products.description: A variety of fragrance products sold in forms such as parfum, eau de parfum, eau de toilette, eau de cologne, and body spray, as well as lotions, creams, powders, candles, and soaps based on particular fragrances. These are manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Hair Care Products
products.description: Hair care products including shampoos, conditioners, styling products, treatments, finishing sprays, and hair color products. These are physically manufactured and distributed through salons, retail, and online channels.

products.name: Licensed Brand Royalties and Ancillary Products
products.description: Royalty revenue from licensing the TOM FORD trademark to third parties and sales from ancillary products and services not fitting within the main categories. This includes licensing of fashion and eyewear brands and other minor product lines.

products.name: Olefins and Co-products
products.description: Basic petrochemicals such as ethylene, propylene, butadiene, and aromatics produced via steam cracking of hydrocarbons in large-scale processing plants. These are fundamental building blocks for plastics and chemicals, delivered via pipeline, rail, or marine transport.

products.name: Polyethylene (PE)
products.description: Thermoplastic polymers (high density, low density, linear low-density) manufactured from ethylene in large-scale plants, used in packaging, housewares, construction, and industrial applications. Delivered in bulk to customers and distributors globally.

products.name: Polypropylene (PP)
products.description: Thermoplastic polymers (homopolymers and copolymers) produced from propylene, used in packaging, automotive, and consumer goods. Manufactured in large plants and distributed globally to customers and distributors.

products.name: Propylene Oxide and Derivatives
products.description: Propylene oxide and its derivatives (polyols, propylene glycol, glycol ethers, butanediol) produced via proprietary technologies in dedicated facilities. Used in polyurethanes, coatings, surfactants, and other applications. Distributed globally via barge, pipeline, and truck.

products.name: Oxyfuels and Related Products
products.description: Ether-based oxyfuels (MTBE, ETBE) and C4 chemicals produced from TBA co-product of propylene oxide. Used as high-octane gasoline components and in synthetic rubber. Manufactured in large plants and shipped globally by barge, pipeline, and truck.

products.name: Intermediate Chemicals (Styrene Monomer and Acetyls)
products.description: Commodity chemicals including styrene monomer and acetyls (methanol, glacial acetic acid, vinyl acetate monomer) produced in large-scale chemical plants. Used in plastics, coatings, adhesives, and other industrial applications. Distributed globally by barge, pipeline, and truck.

products.name: Advanced Polymer Solutions (Compounds and Solutions)
products.description: Polypropylene compounds, engineered plastics, masterbatches, engineered composites, and color concentrates produced by blending polymers and additives. Focused on automotive, packaging, agriculture, and durable goods. Manufactured in specialized facilities and delivered to customers by truck or rail.

products.name: Process Technology Licensing and Polyolefin Catalysts
products.description: Development and external licensing of proprietary chemical and polyolefin process technologies, and manufacture and sale of polyolefin catalysts. Includes technical services, project assistance, and ongoing support for licensees. Delivered as technology packages and catalyst shipments.

products.name: Circular & Low Carbon Solutions (Recycled and Renewable-based Polymers)
products.description: Production and marketing of recycled and renewable-based polymers using proprietary recycling technologies and sourcing of recycled/renewable feedstocks. Delivered as sustainable materials to customers seeking circular solutions, leveraging existing and new recycling facilities.

products.name: Multi-family and Healthcare Facility Mortgage Banking
products.description: Origination, servicing, and sale of loans for affordable multi-family rental housing and healthcare facilities, including bridge, construction, and permanent loans, often sold to government agencies with servicing rights retained. Delivered through a national platform with agency licenses (FHA, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, USDA).

products.name: Tax Credit Equity Syndication and Asset Management
products.description: Syndication of low-income housing tax credit (LIHTC) and other tax-advantaged funds for affordable housing projects, including fund management and asset servicing for institutional investors. Delivered through in-house underwriting and servicing teams.

products.name: Mortgage Warehousing
products.description: Provision of warehouse lines of credit and asset-based financing to non-depository financial institutions and mortgage bankers, enabling them to fund and inventory residential and multi-family mortgage loans until sale in the secondary market. Delivered via secured lending facilities and repurchase agreements.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Origination and portfolio management of commercial loans, including owner-occupied commercial real estate, commercial and industrial loans, and bridge/construction loans for multi-family and healthcare projects. Delivered through direct lending and relationship banking, primarily funded by deposits.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Provision of loans and lines of credit for crop and livestock production, equipment and real estate purchases, including participation in government programs (Farmer Mac, Farm Service Agency). Delivered through specialized agricultural banking offices and secondary market sales.

products.name: Single-Family Mortgage Lending and Servicing
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of single-family residential mortgages, including retail and correspondent channels, agency-eligible, jumbo, construction, bridge, and HELOC products. Delivered nationally with approvals from FHA, VA, USDA, Ginnie Mae, Fannie Mae, and Freddie Mac.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of SBA 7(a), 504, and Express loans to small businesses, with delegated authority as a Preferred Lender. Delivered regionally through dedicated SBA lending offices.

products.name: Retail and Community Banking Services
products.description: Provision of traditional banking services including deposit accounts, consumer loans, and online/mobile banking to individuals and businesses, primarily in Indiana but with a growing national presence. Delivered through physical branches and digital platforms.

firms.firm: Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. of Louisiana

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of one-to-four family residential mortgage loans, including conventional, rural development, FHA, and VA loans, primarily through in-person loan officers and subject to federal underwriting standards. Loans are sometimes sold to correspondent banks or government-sponsored entities.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate, including both owner-occupied and non-owner occupied properties, with fixed or variable rates and terms up to 15 years, delivered through in-person banking relationships and subject to internal underwriting standards.

products.name: Multi-Family Residential Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for multi-family residential properties (five or more units), including income-producing and low-income housing developments, typically requiring personal guarantees and in-person underwriting.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Provision of commercial business loans and lines of credit, including inventory financing and equipment loans, primarily to small- and mid-sized businesses in the local market, requiring personal guarantees and in-person relationship management.

products.name: Land and Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for land acquisition (both for development and unimproved land) and construction loans for residential and commercial properties, with fixed rates and short to medium terms, requiring personal guarantees and collateral.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Lines of Credit
products.description: Provision of home equity loans, second mortgages, and equity lines of credit secured by residential real estate, with varying terms and rates, delivered through in-person application and underwriting processes.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Origination of consumer loans not secured by real estate, including loans secured by deposit accounts, automobile loans, overdraft protection, and other unsecured loans, typically with shorter terms and higher interest rates.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a range of deposit accounts to retail and business customers, including savings accounts, checking (NOW and non-interest bearing), money market accounts, and certificates of deposit, managed through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: New Vehicle Sales
products.description: Retail sale of new vehicles from 30 different brands, acquired directly from manufacturers or through dealer trades, delivered through physical dealership locations.

products.name: Used Vehicle Sales
products.description: Retail sale of used vehicles sourced from trade-ins, auctions, lease terminations, and direct purchases, reconditioned and sold through dealerships and AutoNation USA used vehicle stores.

products.name: Parts and Service (After-Sales)
products.description: Provision of automotive repair, maintenance, and collision repair services, as well as sale of automotive parts and accessories, delivered through service departments, collision centers, mobile repair, and e-commerce.

products.name: Wholesale Parts Sales
products.description: Sale of automotive parts to collision repair shops and independent vehicle repair providers, distributed through parts distribution centers and wholesale operations.

products.name: Automotive Finance and Insurance Products
products.description: Arrangement of vehicle financing through third-party lenders and captive finance company, and sale of vehicle protection products such as service contracts, maintenance programs, and GAP insurance, delivered at point of sale and online.

products.name: Automotive Auction Services
products.description: Operation of automotive auctions for wholesale disposition of vehicles not sold at retail, serving dealers and other wholesale buyers through dedicated auction facilities.

products.name: Mobile Automotive Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of repair and maintenance services at customer locations via a mobile service business, utilizing in-person human labor and mobile infrastructure.

products.name: Waste Paper Export Transportation Services
products.description: Truckload transportation of waste paper products from recycling centers and waste companies to major ports for export, using a fleet of chassis trucks and containers. This service involves physical hauling, regulated logistics, and time-sensitive delivery.

products.name: Scrap Metal and Wood Products Export Transportation
products.description: Truckload transportation of scrap metal (ferrous and non-ferrous) and wood products (logs, timber) from suppliers to ports for export, using similar logistics and equipment as waste paper transport. This service is subject to commodity price and seasonal fluctuations.

products.name: Import Container Transportation Services
products.description: Transport of cargo-filled containers from ports (primarily Newark, NJ and Philadelphia, PA) to customer-designated delivery locations, utilizing a fleet of trucks and chassis for regulated, time-sensitive deliveries.

products.name: Refrigerated (Cold-Chain) Logistics Services
products.description: Management and transportation of refrigerated containers at major ports, providing cold-chain logistics for temperature-sensitive cargo. This service leverages specialized equipment and regulated handling.

products.name: Logistics Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage of trucking and logistics solutions for loads not handled by the company’s own fleet, including plastics, specialty commodities, and shipments involving major ports and commercial rail lines. This service involves arranging third-party carriers and managing logistics coordination.

products.name: First Aid and Medical Products
products.description: Manufacture and assembly of first aid kits, safety products, trauma and emergency response kits, over-the-counter medications, antiseptic wipes, and related medical supplies, delivered through both direct and distributor channels. Production involves regulatory compliance, physical assembly, and both domestic and international sourcing.

products.name: Spill Clean-Up Solutions
products.description: Production and distribution of absorbent powders and spill response systems for bodily fluid and general spill clean-up, primarily for commercial, industrial, and retail environments. Products are manufactured in dedicated facilities and delivered as physical goods.

products.name: Cutting Tools for School, Home, and Office
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of scissors, rulers, paper trimmers, safety cutters, pencil sharpeners, and craft tools for educational, home, and office use. Products feature proprietary coatings and are distributed under the Westcott brand.

products.name: Industrial and Professional Cutting Tools
products.description: Manufacture and sale of cutting tools such as knives, shears, and specialty blades for hardware, industrial, floral, sewing, and housewares markets, utilizing advanced materials and coatings for enhanced performance. Distributed under the Clauss brand.

products.name: Sharpening Tools and Solutions
products.description: Development and sale of diamond-based sharpening tools and systems for knives, scissors, chisels, and other edged tools, serving both consumer and professional markets. Products are manufactured using proprietary diamond bonding processes and distributed under the DMT brand.

products.name: Sterile Intravenous (IV) Solutions
products.description: Manufactured sterile IV fluids used for patient hydration and medication delivery, produced in regulated facilities and distributed globally to healthcare providers.

products.name: Infusion Systems and Administration Sets
products.description: Physical infusion pumps and related administration sets for controlled delivery of fluids and medications, requiring regulated manufacturing and distribution to hospitals and clinics.

products.name: Parenteral Nutrition Therapies
products.description: Manufactured nutritional solutions for intravenous feeding of patients unable to eat, produced in sterile environments and delivered to healthcare facilities.

products.name: Surgical Hemostat, Sealant, and Adhesion Prevention Products
products.description: Specialized consumable products used during surgery to control bleeding, seal tissues, and prevent adhesions, manufactured under strict quality controls and supplied to surgical centers.

products.name: Advanced Surgical Equipment and Operating Room Integration Technologies
products.description: Physical devices and integrated systems for surgical environments, including precision positioning devices and operating room integration, requiring advanced manufacturing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Smart Bed Systems
products.description: Digitally connected hospital bed systems with monitoring and communication capabilities, manufactured and distributed to healthcare facilities for patient care and safety.

products.name: Patient Monitoring and Diagnostic Technologies
products.description: Electronic devices and software for monitoring patient vital signs and diagnostics, produced in regulated facilities and delivered to hospitals and clinics.

products.name: Respiratory Health Devices
products.description: Manufactured devices for respiratory therapy and support, distributed to hospitals and home care settings for patients with breathing difficulties.

products.name: Specialty Injectable Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Manufactured generic and specialty injectable drugs for hospital and clinical use, produced in compliance with pharmaceutical regulations and distributed globally.

products.name: Inhaled Anesthetics
products.description: Manufactured anesthetic gases and vapors for surgical procedures, produced in specialized facilities and supplied to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: Drug Compounding Services
products.description: Preparation and customization of pharmaceutical products for hospitals and clinics, involving regulated compounding processes and delivery to healthcare providers.

products.name: Connected Care Solutions and Collaboration Tools
products.description: Digital platforms and devices that enable data connectivity, communication, and analytics for healthcare providers, delivered as integrated solutions to hospitals and clinics.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, extraction, and sale of crude oil from onshore and offshore fields in the U.S. (primarily Permian Basin), Egypt (Western Desert), and the North Sea (U.K.), delivered via pipelines or export terminals to refiners, marketers, and integrated oil companies. Requires significant physical infrastructure, drilling, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, extraction, and sale of natural gas from onshore and offshore fields in the U.S., Egypt, and the North Sea, delivered to utilities, local distribution companies, midstream companies, and end-users via pipelines. Involves drilling, gathering, processing, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of NGLs (such as propane, butane, condensate) as byproducts of oil and gas production, primarily in the U.S. and North Sea, sold under contracts based on Gulf Coast or index pricing. Requires processing and fractionation facilities.

products.name: Oil and Gas Exploration and Appraisal Services (International New Ventures)
products.description: Exploration and appraisal of oil and gas resources in new international locations (e.g., Suriname, Uruguay, Alaska), including seismic surveys, drilling, and joint venture development. These activities may result in future production and sales but currently focus on discovering and evaluating new reserves.

products.name: Power Grid and Microwave Tubes and Components
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes power grid and microwave tubes, RF and microwave components, and related consumables for industrial, scientific, medical, communications, and military applications. Products are physically manufactured in-house or by partners to strict specifications and distributed globally.

products.name: Green Energy Solutions and Power Management Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes products for energy storage, power management, and green energy applications such as wind, solar, hydrogen, and electric vehicles. Involves physical manufacturing and systems integration for industrial and alternative energy markets.

products.name: Customized Display Solutions
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sources, and supports custom display solutions including touch screens, protective panels, custom enclosures, All-In-One computers, and application-specific software for OEMs in healthcare, industrial, financial, and corporate markets. Delivered as physical products and integrated systems.

products.name: Diagnostic Imaging Replacement Parts and Equipment
products.description: Manufactures, repairs, refurbishes, and distributes high-value replacement parts and equipment for diagnostic imaging systems (CT, MRI), including tubes, amplifiers, and flat panel detector upgrades, primarily for healthcare providers and service organizations. Involves physical manufacturing, repair, and logistics.

products.name: Aftermarket Technical Service and Repair
products.description: Provides aftermarket technical service and repair for microwave and industrial equipment, as well as diagnostic imaging systems, leveraging global infrastructure and technical expertise. Delivered through in-person human labor and technical support.

products.name: Sensors
products.description: CTS designs and manufactures a broad range of sensors, including controls, pedals, piezo sensing products, switches, and transducers, primarily for OEMs in transportation, industrial, medical, and aerospace and defense markets. These are engineered physical components produced in global manufacturing facilities and integrated into customers' electronic systems.

products.name: Connectivity Components
products.description: CTS produces connectivity components such as EMI/RFI filters, capacitors, frequency control products, resistors, and RF filters. These are manufactured physical components that enable electronic systems to synchronize and communicate, serving industrial, medical, and aerospace and defense markets.

products.name: Actuators
products.description: CTS manufactures actuators, including piezo microactuators and rotary actuators, which are engineered devices that provide precise movement in electronic systems for transportation, industrial, and medical applications. These are produced in CTS's global manufacturing facilities and integrated into customer products.
